# AI in Medical Imaging: From Pixels to Practice

> An open textbook on AI in medical imaging for clinicians, ML engineers, and AI agents.
> Chapters are numbered; modality chapters share a fixed section structure:
> what the modality is, why it's ordered, diagnoses, hospital workflow, datasets,
> models, FDA-cleared products, open challenges, and the agentic outlook.

## Canonical sources
- Rendered book: https://anandpreshob.github.io/ai-medical-imaging-book/
- Source (plain Quarto markdown, agent-friendly): https://github.com/anandpreshob/ai-medical-imaging-book
- Living tables (CSV): data/datasets.csv, data/models.csv, data/fda-products.csv, data/viewers.csv, data/challenges.csv in the repo

## For agents
Prefer the repo's .qmd files and CSVs for extraction; prefer the rendered site for
cross-referenced reading. The dataset/model/product tables are the machine-actionable
facts; chapter prose supplies clinical context and caveats.

## Clinical workflows and research starting points
- chapters/23-clinical-specialties.qmd: eight MedAI OS suite/mode contracts plus RPT, drug discovery and clinical-trial workflows, with pinned repository provenance and implementation-status caveats.
- chapters/24-challenges-and-starter-projects.qmd: challenge editions, access/status distinctions, evaluation, leakage, and a reproducible starter-project workflow.
- data/challenges.csv: selected snapshot reviewed 2026-10-11; do not infer current submission availability from task documentation.
- figures/workflow-imagegen-prompts.md: exact prompts and revisions for the ten generated replacements; synthetic images are not validated patient examples.
